audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers claim Sylas can interrupt Flamespitter: content.early says 'a Level 1 Sylas with E can chain-dash and interrupt your channel' and content.whys[2] says 'his E stun can interrupt your Q channel'.
audit.why: Flamespitter is not a channel. Riot's text describes it as damage 'in a cone for 3 seconds' with no channel wording, and the kit's derived flag set gives it only 'zone' — no 'channel' flag. That flag vocabulary is demonstrably live across the library (40 abilities carry it, including Fiddlesticks Drain, Master Yi Meditate and Karthus Requiem), so its absence on Flamespitter is meaningful rather than an omission. Getting stunned stops Rumble repositioning the cone; it does not cancel the burn. The current text tells the player to fear an interrupt that does not exist, which makes him decline trades he actually wins.
audit.corrected: Flamespitter keeps burning through his crowd control — the cost of eating Abduct is losing the cone's aim, not losing the ability.
sources: champ-data/_kits/rumble.json (Q Flamespitter, flags: zone only, '3 seconds')
champ-data/_kits (channel flag applied to 40 other abilities)

audit.whatIsWrong: The Equalizer-theft problem is raised four times (spikes[1], spikes[3], whys[4], wants.foe[1], late) but the decisive number behind it is never given.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30 seconds. The Equalizer is 130/105/80. At level 6 Sylas gets your ultimate back on an 80-second timer while you wait 130 — he can use your own ultimate roughly 1.6 times per one of yours, and by his rank 3 (30s) that ratio is brutal. This single ratio explains every piece of 'do not ult near him' advice already in the entry, and without it the advice reads as vague caution.
audit.corrected: Hijack at 80s against The Equalizer at 130s — he gets your ultimate back before you do, so the fear is arithmetic, not vibes.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid claims 'his E cooldown is short enough to chain two engages if you waste Scrap Shield on the first one' at levels 4-5.
audit.why: Abscond/Abduct is 13/12/11/10/9 seconds. At levels 4-5 Sylas has it at rank 2 or 3, i.e. 12 or 11 seconds. That does not come back twice inside a single trade window — a Rumble trade is over in a few seconds. The real constraint is the opposite one: Scrap Shield is on a flat 6-second cooldown, so it is up roughly twice per Abscond. Telling the player his shield will be punished for existing gets the trade maths backwards.
audit.corrected: Abscond is 12-11s at levels 4-5 against a 6s Scrap Shield — you get two shields per dash, so use the first one freely.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer never names a single Sylas ability — it uses 'his E', 'his W drain', 'his R' throughout. Chain Lash and Petricite Burst are not referenced at all, in any form.
audit.why: Chain Lash (Q) at 775 range is Sylas's only ranged tool and his main lane damage; Petricite Burst (P) is the empowered attack after every cast and is the actual shape of his trading pattern. An entry that omits both is describing a different champion's lane. Naming matters here beyond polish: Chain Lash at 775 versus Electro-Harpoon at 850 is the range relationship the whole lane runs on.
audit.corrected: Name Chain Lash (775, his only ranged tool), Kingslayer (400 lunge heal), Abscond/Abduct (400 dash, recast pull) and Hijack, and anchor the poke war on Electro-Harpoon's 850 outranging all of it.

audit.why: The _missing-interactions 'needs-antiheal' row for Kingslayer is already served by full.breakdown.late ('anti-heal stays core'). The content layer references the heal twice without naming it, which the edits fix; no separate itemisation change is needed.

edits.before: At Level 1 you want Flamespitter in his face immediately — Sylas has no answer to sustained magic damage at close range before he gets his E. Walk at him, but track whether he took E first, because a Level 1 Sylas with E can chain-dash and interrupt your channel. Level 2 is your best moment: Q into double Electro-Harpoon prevents him from walking out of Flamespitter range, and his W drain requires him to be on top of you to heal — do not let him get there. By Level 3 you have the full combo but so does he: his E stun into W drain trades evenly if you mistime Scrap Shield, so bait the dash, pop W when the chain is in the air, and burn him with Danger Zone Flamespitter while he is slowed by your harpoon.
edits.after: At Level 1 walk at him with Flamespitter — Sylas has no answer to sustained magic damage up close, though Chain Lash at 775 outranges your 600 cone, so trade only when he has spent it. Level 2 is your best moment: Q into double Electro-Harpoon stops him leaving the cone, and Kingslayer is a 400-range lunge, so he must be on top of you to heal — deny him that. By Level 3 you both have full kits: Abduct into Kingslayer trades evenly if you mistime Scrap Shield, so bait the dash, pop W as the chain flies, and burn him at Danger Zone while the harpoon slow holds him. His crowd control does not cancel Flamespitter — the flames keep burning, you just lose the aim.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are where the matchup tightens — Sylas hits his best pre-6 sustain window and his E cooldown is short enough to chain two engages if you waste Scrap Shield on the first one. Trade only when you have a fresh Danger Zone window and both harpoons available; one Electro-Harpoon per trade is not enough to keep him off you while Flamespitter channels. At Level 6 you have Equalizer but so will he the moment he walks near you — avoid pointing the wall so it clips your own position, and never use it as an aggressive engage when he can immediately steal and redirect it. Use Equalizer to cut his retreat or zone him off the wave, not to start fights in a narrow lane.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are where it tightens — Sylas hits his best pre-6 sustain window off Kingslayer. Abscond is 12-11s at these ranks against a flat 6s Scrap Shield, so you get two shields per dash and can spend the first one freely. Trade on a fresh Danger Zone window with both harpoons up; one Electro-Harpoon does not hold him off the cone. At Level 6 you get Equalizer and so does he — Hijack is 80s to your 130s, so he returns your own ultimate faster than you do. Never point the wall so it clips you, and never open with it in a narrow lane. Use Equalizer to cut his retreat or zone him off the wave, not to start fights.

edits.before: Equalizer is your trump card — but Sylas can steal it with his R, so never fight him in a choke where the wall hits you too.
edits.after: Equalizer is your trump card, but Hijack is 80s against its 130s — he gets your own ultimate back faster than you do.

edits.before: Your Q-into-double-E combo comes fully online — punish Sylas hard before his E chain-dash stun lets him stick to you through Scrap Shield.
edits.after: Your Q-into-double-E combo comes fully online — punish Sylas hard before Abscond and its Abduct recast let him chain onto you through Scrap Shield.

edits.before: Full kit online but his E stun can interrupt your Q channel — bait the dash, then Scrap Shield absorbs the chain and you burn him at Danger Zone heat.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Abduct cannot cancel Flamespitter — it only costs you the cone's aim. Bait the dash, shield the chain, burn him at Danger Zone heat.

edits.before: He sustains through short trades with W drain and E lets him reset distance; only commit when both harpoons are up and your Heat is in the 50-100 band.
edits.after: Kingslayer heals him through short trades and Abscond resets the gap; only commit with both harpoons up and your Heat parked in the 50-100 band.

edits.before: Equalizer is a legitimate spike but he can steal it immediately — use it to zone or cut off retreat, never as an engage tool he can catch and redirect.
edits.after: Equalizer is a real spike, but Hijack recharges in 80s against its 130s — zone and cut retreats with it, never open a fight he can steal and mirror.

edits.before: Land Flamespitter in the Danger Zone before Sylas activates his E chain-dash so he cannot close on you cleanly
edits.after: Land Flamespitter at Danger Zone before Abscond is up, and answer Chain Lash with Electro-Harpoon — 850 beats 775

edits.before: Keep Scrap Shield ready for his E stun — eat the chain on the shield, not your health bar
edits.after: Keep Scrap Shield ready for the Abduct chain — eat it on the shield, not your health bar

edits.before: Steal your Equalizer with his R and drop it back on you in the same teamfight

edits.before: Flamespitter wins every melee level 1 — walk at them. Identify how Sylas contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Flamespitter beats him up close, but Chain Lash reaches 775 to your 600 — walk in only once he has spent it, and harpoon him meanwhile.

notes:
FALSE POSITIVE in suspectNames: 'Use Equalizer' in wants.you[2] is correct shorthand for The Equalizer — flagged purely on edit distance against the lowercased canonical name. Do not change it.

I did NOT touch the 'stun' language attached to Abscond/Abduct, even though Riot's Data Dragon text for the ability mentions only a dash and a recast pull and the derived flags give it 'projectile' + 'dash' with no hardCC. Abduct's stun is real in game but is exactly the sort of detail Data Dragon's short text drops, so per the brief I left every existing stun reference alone rather than asserting either way from the kit file. If you want it stated with a duration, that needs a League Wiki check.

The defect 'never names any of Sylas's abilities' applies only to the CONTENT layer. The full layer already names Abscond / Abduct heavily (arguably too heavily — it is the auto-generated 'track his key tool' template repeated in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, ahead, four phases and six breakdown keys). The edits add Chain Lash, Kingslayer, Abduct and Hijack to the content layer.

Worth knowing: Chain Lash (775) and Kingslayer (400) mean Electro-Harpoon at 850 outranges every tool Sylas has. That relationship was absent from the entry and is now the spine of the early/mid text.

full.diff reads EVEN at a 47.33% win rate over 2174 games — that is the largest sample in my slice and it is a losing lane, not an even one. Not proposed as an edit because 'EVEN' cannot reach 'UNFAVOURED' inside the ±10% length band.
